work.abstract_text: We extend the Stirling determinant formulas of Merca (2014) and Amdeberhan–Ekhad (2022), giving a corrected subset expansion and a normalized proof of Kurkov's OEIS A396563 FORMULA conjecture, approved revision 15 (1 June 2026). The minor equals s_(k^m)(1,2,...,n+m) for all n,k >= 0, m >= 1; allowing every integer exponent yields a vanishing interval and an entire reciprocal-power family, including Kurkov's A132393 FORMULA conjecture (24 May 2026). We recover the earlier rational row generating functions and give a second-kind moment determinant. We also correct the alphabet in their second-kind Schur evaluation. Companion recurrences and two generating-function normalizations are treated with explicit attribution and coverage.

work.title: Corrected formulas and integer exponents for Amdeberhan–Ekhad (2022): Kurkov's OEIS A396563 FORMULA conjecture, revision 15 (1 June 2026)
